title: the update that adds the great lakes... and other stuff too i guess

sections.heading: New look
items: Redid the whole map UI. The map now takes up the entire screen, with panels on top, a purple grid frame and new fonts.
Faction list has its own panel now, and you can hide it if you want more space for the map.
Click a territory to see its info, click somewhere else to close it.
The Great Lakes are finally actual water, along with the other lakes. Oceans and coastlines also have a bit of glow now.

sections.heading: Added
items: Mountains and higher ground now look different from flat land.
Faction borders now have a glow.
Added a labels button so you can switch between names, flags or no labels.
Added a share button that copies a link to your current view, or to a specific faction.
You can now save your current map view as a PNG.
Added zoom buttons, a zoom readout and a button to zoom straight to a territory from faction cards.
Land being claimed now has those moving stripe things.

sections.heading: Tweaked
items: Hovering over factions now shows their colour, and region names are shown instead of cell numbers.
Removed the pan and zoom instructions from the bottom bar because you can probably figure that out.
